title: K-flat transport through the native ringed equivalence
statement: Fix b, T and the finite-field hypotheses of lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-kflat-data, and assume the underived adjunction adj : T ⊣₂ ihomBifunctor k₀ l X from that interface. For every cochain complex P, NativeTensorKFlat P implies that b.native sends P to an independent-coefficient K-flat complex over b.R [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: Let e be the equivalence b.native applied termwise to cochain complexes. Given a ringed acyclic test N, e.inverse(N) is acyclic because the inverse additive equivalence is exact. NativeTensorKFlat makes T(P,e.inverse(N)) acyclic. Applying b.native preserves acyclicity. Compose the chain isomorphism with coefficientTotalTensor applied to the product of e.counitIso at N and the identity of e(P). The result identifies this acyclic complex with the ringed tensor of N and e(P). ExactAt.of_iso in each degree proves the required independent-coefficient K-flatness. No K-flat replacement or flat-term assertion is used.

theorem native_weil_tensor_ringed_kflat_flat (adj : T ⊣₂ ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) :
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ),
      NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X T P →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := b.R)
          ((b.native.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
